description:
Costs 10¢ per call. That is the upload fee, charged only when the file passes its checks. Confirms an upload started with request_datasheet_upload: pass its upload_token. The server re-hashes the uploaded bytes, checks it is a PDF with the MPN on the first page, adds it to your organisation's private library and queues extraction. Success returns document_id, mpn, sha256, file_size_bytes and status='pending'; poll check_extraction_status with the MPN. A new datasheet takes about 2.5 minutes at the median and 6.5 minutes at the 90th percentile; a cold GPU start can take about 12 minutes. These are estimates, not deadlines.
Failures (not charged): 'upload_not_found' (no bytes yet; retry the PUT), 'sha256_mismatch' (re-hash and re-request), 'invalid_pdf', 'mpn_not_in_pdf' (wrong file, or scanned image-only), 'token_expired' (older than 15 minutes; start again).
name: confirm_datasheet_upload
title: Confirm Datasheet Upload
